title: Approve or block immutable matrix versions for feature/model experimentation
scope: Atomic matrix-admission decision only. This gate evaluates the exact BAT-397 content-addressed matrix and does not create, repair, or widen its real population.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: State rows retain canonical identity, effective/known-at time, source evidence, and version; corrections append and future observations do not alter prior as-of reads.
acceptance_matrix.observable_result: BAT-396 preserved all 313,712 temporal candidates and their evidence/version fields, admitted zero without source-known-at evidence, and passed append-only correction replay without promoting synthetic evidence.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Each game/cutoff row uses only eligible state and deterministically preserves site, lower-division, cancellation, fallback, missingness, and lineage rules.
acceptance_matrix.observable_result: BAT-397 passed sixteen deterministic contract assertions, but the real matrix contains zero game/cutoff rows and zero cells.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: Approved matrices are content-hashed, split-blind, reproducible from pinned versions, and cannot pass on successful file creation alone.
acceptance_matrix.observable_result: The immutable matrix is content-addressed and reproducible, but has no accepted row, real cutoff replay, or applicable split identity. File creation is insufficient; approval is denied.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: All prerequisite evidence is linked and unresolved blockers remain explicit; file creation alone cannot pass this gate.
acceptance_matrix.observable_result: All six prerequisite artifacts/evidence manifests are pinned and validated, the six admission blockers are explicit, and 23 downstream units remain blocked from consuming this matrix.

test_matrix.result: Temporal regression: 4 passed and 16 subtests; full repository suite: 316 passed, 2 skipped, 79 subtests.
No evidence-backed real game/cutoff row exists; synthetic prerequisite replay remains PASS but cannot establish real readiness.
No nonempty matrix, target, split, model, prediction, or protected evaluation exists.
The exact prerequisite chain resolves to a deterministic downstream-consumable BLOCK decision with no manual reconstruction.
Six prerequisite identities, producer/runtime identity, byte-identical rebuild, and independent mutation validation are recorded.

commands.command: run build_matrix_gate_decision.py twice against the six pinned prerequisite identities
run validate_matrix_gate_decision.py against decision, six prerequisite identities, two external matrix payloads, and 12 mutation probes
commands.result: PASS: zero findings; both payloads confirmed empty; all unsafe mutations rejected
PASS: PIT/leakage and synthetic E2E/replay controls

commands.command: write provenance; strict repository, autonomous, W25, Jira pack/source/dependency/import/second-pass/control-plane/manifest validation
commands.result: PASS: 2,119 source references, 474 Jira derivatives, 1,804 Jira manifest files

negative_findings: The 959,765-row known-at evaluation admitted zero records.
All 313,712 temporal candidates remain quarantined and accepted as-of state is empty.
No real game/cutoff catalog, matrix row, matrix cell, chronological replay, or split identity exists.
Content addressing and synthetic validation do not compensate for an empty empirical population.
honesty_boundary: The admission gate itself can be production-ready while correctly returning BLOCK for an ineligible matrix.

BAT-398 does not establish historical completeness, GAP-002/GAP-003 resolution, an approved training matrix, production-model readiness, protected performance, a champion, A&M lift, BAS, Aggie Excess, or any scientific result.
